_comment: Spirits (2026-11-13, integrator B2), Mausoleum Wanderer's until-end-of-turn pump: a non-sick Wanderer (1/1) and Lingering Souls in hand on three lands. Opponent 3. Casting Souls before combat makes two Spirit tokens; each entry gives the Wanderer +1/+1 until end of turn, so it attacks as a 3/3 and kills T4. Without the pump it hits for 1 (T4 -> 2; T5 Wanderer 1 + tokens 2 = 3 -> kill T5).
